projects.owner: West Virginia School of Osteopathic Medicine
projects.description: $35M, 28,523 SF expansion and renovation of the Frederic W. Smith Science Building. Phase 1 demolition and MEP infrastructure completed June 2026. Includes research labs, computer lab, and a 3rd story for public-private research.

sources.title: Construction continues as WVSOM science building expansion takes shape - WVDN

sources.title: Construction of St. Joseph’s Cancer Complex Beginning this Summer - Lede News
